items.label: Free Supercharging
items.text: Credited to your Tesla account, usable at Tesla-owned Superchargers.

items.label: New vehicles
items.text: Your first Model 3 or Model Y, custom ordered or from new inventory. Used cars don't qualify.

items.label: Where you order
items.text: Tesla sets the benefit per country. What your order summary on Tesla's site shows is what you get.

items.title: Open the referral link
items.text: It takes you to Tesla's own website with the referral already applied.

items.title: Configure and order
items.text: Order in the same visit. Check the referral appears in your order summary before you pay.

items.title: Enjoy the Supercharging
items.text: The credit is granted when you take delivery and then shows up in your Tesla app.

items.q: Does using the code cost me anything?
items.a: No. The car's price is the same with or without the referral. You get the free Supercharging on top if the referral shows in your order summary, so check it before you pay.

items.q: Is there a Tesla referral discount in Europe?
items.a: Not on the price. For Model 3 and Model Y, Tesla's referral offer in Europe currently gives buyers {km} km of free Supercharging (checked on {checkedOn}) rather than money off the car.

items.q: Does the code work for Model S or Model X?
items.a: My referral link currently shows a benefit only for new Model 3 and Model Y. For Model S or Model X, check Tesla's referral terms for your country.

items.q: Can I use the code if I order in another European country?
items.a: The link opens Tesla's website, where you choose the country you order in. The benefit you get is the one Tesla offers in that country, so check that it shows in your order summary before you pay.

items.q: Can I add the code after I've ordered?
items.a: No. Tesla only applies a referral if you order through the link. It can't be added to an existing order.

New Model 3 and Model Y, either custom ordered or bought as new inventory. Used and certified pre-owned cars don't qualify. For demo cars, check that the referral is shown on the order page before you pay.

items.q: Can I use the code if I already own a Tesla?
items.a: Only if it's your first Model 3 or Model Y. Tesla gives the buyer benefit once, on your first eligible purchase through a referral link, and you must be at least 18. Existing owners can get Tesla's loyalty benefits instead.

items.q: How long is the Supercharging credit valid?
items.a: According to Tesla's terms, the benefit expires 12 months after it's granted, which happens when you take delivery. It has no cash value, can't be transferred, only works at Tesla-owned Superchargers and ends if you sell the car. If Tesla ends the program, unused benefits may be cancelled.

items.q: What do you get out of it?
items.a: When you order through my link, Tesla gives me a referral reward too (Supercharging credit or Tesla Credits). That's why this page exists. Your price is the same either way.
No. This is an independent page run by a Tesla owner. The order itself happens entirely on Tesla's official website.
